name: Shining Knight
summary: A consummate mounted champion whose divine grace protects her steed and whose charge terrifies smitten foes.

features.name: Skilled Rider
features.summary: Ignore armor check penalties on Ride checks and grant a ridden mount the benefit of Divine Grace.

features.name: Bonded Mount
features.summary: The Divine Bond must be a loyal celestial mount and otherwise advances as the standard Paladin mount bond.
features.uses: once per day plus one every 4 levels after 5th

features.name: Knight's Charge
features.summary: Mounted charges do not provoke; a hit against a smite target forces a Will save or panics it for half Paladin level rounds.
